Preparing for travel day is easier when you know what the Companion Animal Travel Desk will need from you.

Traveling with your companion animal

Aurelia Skyways uses the Companion Animal Travel Desk to coordinate care from booking through pickup. Start by sharing basic travel details, then stay in touch with the passenger coordinator if anything changes. Clear, prompt messages help the team match the plan to your animal's needs.

<<FACT F091>> Keep your reservation notes handy, because the desk may ask for supporting details before the process moves ahead. The goal is to set up a safe, workable plan without last-minute confusion. If your travel plans change, let the team know as soon as possible so the record stays current.

Before check-in, review the instructions you received and pack the items your animal will need for comfort and calm. <<FACT F086>> Bring any required paperwork with you and keep it easy to reach. The desk will use the information on file to confirm the care setup and reduce delays at the airport.

Different animals need different handling. Species, temperament, and comfort all matter, so describe your pet honestly and plainly. If your animal is nervous, crate-trained, or sensitive to noise, say so early. This helps the coordinator prepare the right support and avoids unnecessary stress on travel day.

At the airport, follow the staff guidance and stay available until the handoff is complete. Respectful communication makes the process smoother for you, your animal, and the ground team. If you are unsure about any step, ask before you leave the counter area.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk directly through Aurelia Skyways customer support.
